title: Unit Price
description: Stops shoppers picking the pack that only looks cheaper by putting every option on a common unit price (₹ per 100 g, per litre or per piece), marking the true cheapest, and catching bigger packs that cost more per unit, multi-buys that cost more than singles and packs that shrank at the same price, with a one-tap switch.
stops: Bigger pack costs more per kg
